outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: The agent’s wording/formatting for additions/deletions (e.g., restating the diffstat as “45 changes: 26 additions & 19 deletions”) is fine, and not providing a URL is irrelevant. Also, imperfect explicit verification of “non-draft” could be a minor issue if drafts are not present/visible.

Critical issues: (1) The agent did not inspect the first three PRs—only PR #7506 was opened and its Files changed tab viewed. There is no evidence of opening PR #2 or PR #3 or collecting their file-change summaries. (2) Even for PR #7506, the agent output omits several required fields: PR number (it’s implied but not reported as a field), title, author, last-updated date, and labels. Screenshot evidence would have supported at least title/number/author/labels, but the agent did not report them. (3) The agent did not rank the three PRs by changed-file count, which is impossible anyway given only one PR’s file counts were collected.

Outcome assessment based on evidence: Screenshots confirm the agent did manage to reach a state with query `is:pr is:open sort:updated-desc` (so open + most-recently-updated sorting is supported in the latest list state), and successfully viewed PR #7506’s Files changed showing 1 file and +26/−19 with no test files visible. However, the task’s primary deliverable is the full report for the first three PRs plus a ranking by changed-file count. Because the agent only provided partial data for one PR and did not complete inspection/reporting for three PRs (with no environment blocker), the user would not consider the task completed.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to correctly filter the psf/requests GitHub pull request list to open, non-draft PRs sorted by most recently updated, then open and inspect the first three PRs and report a complete set of metadata and file-change stats for each (including whether any test file appears in Files changed), and finally rank the three PRs by changed-file count. A reasonable user would be flexible on minor formatting or whether the agent uses UI controls vs query syntax, but not flexible on missing two PRs, missing required fields (number/title/author/labels/last-updated), or failing to provide the requested ranking.
